narr: Strong thunderstorms moved southwestward into the Tucson Metro area causing power outages and fire starts due to lightning. Additionally, the storms produced heavy rainfall causing running water over roadways in the Tucson Metro. Heavy rainfall also caused a roadway to close for roughly 24 hours in Benson.
ev: A trained spotter reported flash flooding across roadway. With a nearby measured rainfall of 1.18 inches in 30 minutes.

Heavy rainfall caused flash flooding across Overton Rd due to water moving through the Canada del Oro Wash. Overton Rd remained closed from La Cholla Blvd to La Canada Drive into the following day with an unknown opening time.
lsr: Trained spotter reported flash flooding across roadway. Also measured 1.18 inches in 30 minutes.
